source: Separate sprite sheets referenced against the approved Bilbo Backend character reference.
preparation: Transparent crops normalized onto 1254 × 1254 PNG canvases. The picker uses the existing WebP preparation step.

sheets.prompt:
Create a production sticker SPRITE ATLAS of exactly SIX separate bust illustrations of the SAME established character Bilbo Backend from the image reference, on a TRUE TRANSPARENT alpha background. Landscape atlas with precisely 3 columns and 2 rows. Center coordinates fractions: (1/6,1/4), (1/2,1/4), (5/6,1/4), then (1/6,3/4), (1/2,3/4), (5/6,3/4). All stickers equally sized, each WELL INSIDE its own invisible square cell with at least 10% empty transparent safety margin on all sides. No panels, overlap, grid lines, floor or shop background. Crop to head and upper torso with gestures and explicitly listed compact prop, no legs or feet. One clear distinct silhouette each, warm rich hand-painted gouache and slightly textured digital storybook illustration, brushwork and soft natural light like the reference, not glossy render or generic icon. Preserve the reference's round adult small-folk shopkeeper face, abundant dark chestnut bouncy curls with warm highlights, big rounded rosy nose and cheeks, thick dark brows and friendly brown eyes, softly pointed ears, short sideburns and distinct tiny chin tuft, and signature small central tooth gap visible whenever he smiles. Preserve his recognizable deep moss-green textured buttoned vest with brass buttons and ivory rolled-sleeve shirt. Only expression, pose and explicit compact prop vary. Keep props and graphics close and readable at 48px, in muted teal/amber/berry palette. No text, letters or numbers except explicitly requested simple symbol, no badges with logos, no background, hard shadows, giant halo, white outlines, watermarks or checkerboard. True alpha outside each sticker.
Top-left: Bilbo waves one open hand with the warm tooth-gap smile.
Top-middle: Bilbo gives a big thumbs-up with a crooked grin.
Top-right: Bilbo glances upward, one hand under chin, pensive brows.
Bottom-left: Bilbo cups one hand behind pointed ear and listens attentively.
Bottom-middle: Bilbo raises one index finger beneath a tiny glowing lightbulb, delighted smile.
Bottom-right: Bilbo tilts head under one clearly formed teal question mark, raised brow.
